answer: Shared Fate Ledger. Each identity submits a random marble seed; the protocol derives a shared audit key from all seeds and requires every identity to countersign a ripple of daily cross-checks against that key. A clone cannot predict the key without exposing its seed linkage, so duplication creates a detectable prism of mismatched signatures. Per-identity cost: a full audit cycle plus forfeiture of accumulated checkpoint credits on detection.
